about: UK shows where baby, toddler, nursery and newborn brands and resellers exhibit.

shows.name: Maternity & Midwifery Festivals
shows.venue: London, Bradford, Cardiff, Edinburgh and more
shows.who: A touring series for midwives; 2026 ran in Bradford (June), Cardiff (September) and Edinburgh (November). Baby and feeding brands exhibit.
